acoustic_contract.alignment: sample zero; exact full-clip frame match; no shift, trim, or padding
acoustic_contract.clipping: retain accepted float32 samples unchanged; report receipt warnings
acoustic_contract.scoring_window: full saved stereo WAV including renderer tail
acoustic_contract.silence: reject nonfinite or zero-energy clips; do not floor waveforms

metric_contract.primary: original-level MR-STFT = mean over 512/2048/8192 of spectral convergence + log-magnitude MAE
metric_contract.ties: rank ties receive average rank; pairwise encoder win ties count one half
metric_contract.uncertainty: paired two-way bootstrap over 129 preset families and 12 fixed triplet clusters; descriptive
